arguments.message:
If you received a password‑reset email you didn’t request, it means someone entered your address into the reset flow. The email itself can’t give them access unless they click the link and complete the reset.

**What to do:**
1. Do NOT click the link.
2. Log in to your account (or use the sign‑in page) and review your security settings.
3. Change your password right away as a precaution.
4. If you have two‑factor authentication enabled, reset it as well to invalidate any compromised session.
5. Report the email to our support team so we can review recent access activity and make sure there’s no broader attempt on your account.

Taking these steps will protect your account and let us investigate any suspicious activity.
